articles.summary: Dr. Tiffany Chao is a board-certified general/trauma surgeon and a Clinical Associate Professor of Surgery (affiliated) at Stanford University School of Medicine. In addition to her clinical work, she teaches two Stanford classes, Introduction to Global Health and Advanced Topics in Global Surgery. She is a faculty fellow
articles.title: Meet Dr. Tiffany!

articles.summary: We just reached $20M directed to life-changing healthcare. But the real story is how it happened. From one patient in rural Nepal to thousands more across 34 countries, this milestone proves healthcare for all can be built by all, right now. Read how!
articles.title: Healthcare for all, built by all: our journey to $20 Million
